install: sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' ~/.bashrc 2>/dev/null || true; export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"; grep -qxF 'export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"' ~/.bashrc || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"' >> ~/.bashrc; if ! command -v cargo >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y --no-modify-path --default-toolchain stable --component clippy,rustfmt; else if ! cargo clippy --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then rustup component add clippy; fi; if ! cargo fmt --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then rustup component add rustfmt; fi; fi; cargo fetch --locked && cargo check --workspace --all-targets && if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then node generate-context.js; fi
